title: New villages in the Mawdeep Sinkholes and the Sunscar
changes: Four more villages stand along the highways: Windlass on the rim of the Great Maw and Hempfield by the Old Warren in the Mawdeep Sinkholes, Saltglass on the Glasswind Flats and Last Well under the Ashen Pass road in the Sunscar. Follow the signposted dirt paths off the road.
Each has a portal stone, a bounty board beside it, a villager with a short local quest, and someone to talk to or trade with. Windlass sells armour and Last Well sells flasks.
Monsters stay out of the villages, and the clans can fight over them like the other villages: a held village adds half a town's income to its clan.
